assessment.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí souběžnému tlaku energetického šoku způsobeného konflikty na Blízkém východě, eskalaci bezpečnostních rizik na východním křídle a rostoucí vlně politické nestability poháněné silným nárůstem podpory radikální pravice v Německu a Nizozemsku. Lídři EU mezitím zvažují nouzová opatření včetně plošných daní z neočekávaných zisků energetických firem, zatímco napětí na migračních hranicích eskaluje.
assessment.security_status_en: Europe faces simultaneous pressures from a Middle Eastern energy shock, escalating security risks on its eastern flank, and rising political instability fueled by surging far-right support in Germany and the Netherlands. EU leaders are scrambling to implement emergency measures, including potential bloc-wide windfall taxes on energy firms, while migration pressures intensify at border hotspots.

articles.title: Future of German chancellor hangs in the balance as two states go to polls
articles.summary:
Embattled Friedrich Merz faces nervous wait while far-right Alternative für Deutschland party targets further gains

Voters in two German states are going to the polls with the political future of the embattled chancellor, Friedrich Merz, hanging in the balance and an emboldened far right targeting further gains.

Coming two weeks after a seismic election in Saxony-Anhalt in which the anti-immigration, pro-Kremlin Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) scored its highest ever result in a regional poll, the nativist party is expected to drain support again from Merz’s conservative Christian Democratic Union (CDU).

articles.title: Dutch riot police break up violent far-right protest in The Hague
articles.summary:
Authorities ban anti-immigration march after fireworks and other projectiles thrown at officers in city centre park

Dutch riot police dispersed several hundred far-right protesters in The Hague on Saturday after violence erupted and local authorities banned a planned march in the city against immigration and asylum policies.

The Dutch public broadcaster NOS reported that 24 people had been arrested, after some protesters threw fireworks and other projectiles at police.

articles.title: Record fuel prices across EU prompt calls for bloc-wide windfall tax on firms
articles.summary:
German minister says companies are ‘exploiting situation’ in Middle East, as sky-high prices become major domestic issue for leaders

European governments have discussed imposing a bloc-wide windfall tax on energy companies, as near-record fuel and gas prices pile pressure on leaders desperate to contain mounting public discontent and the challenge of the far right.

With elections due next year in eight EU countries including France, Italy, Spain and Poland, leaders are scrambling to head off the potential fallout from what analysts have warned could be one of the continent’s biggest energy shocks in decades.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí akutnímu energetickému a bezpečnostnímu šoku kvůli geopolitickým konfliktům na Blízkém východě a stupňující se eskalaci války na Ukrajině, kde roste riziko ruských provokací a útoků na hranicích NATO. Politickou stabilitu v regionu navíc zatěžují sílící tlaky na migrační politiku, hrozby protivládních protestů a diskuse o mimořádných daních pro energetické giganty.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing an acute energy and security shock driven by Middle Eastern geopolitical conflicts and escalating warfare in Ukraine, amplifying the risk of Russian provocations near NATO borders. Political stability is further strained by intensifying migration pressures, rising anti-establishment protests, and looming windfall tax debates targeting energy firms.
